title: Shared definitions for compliance-testing skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (sampling_methodology_enum, test_method_enum, exception_disposition_enum) sit alongside the base definitions; they show up across test-plan-builder, control-sampling, workpaper-drafter, exception-analysis.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder. Compliance-testing exception severities use severity_enum_with_moderate where the firm policy uses 'moderate'.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by exception write-ups, workpaper findings, and any artifact that feeds the firm issue log where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Head of Compliance Testing', 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Control Owner', 'Business Process Owner'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common compliance-testing gates: test-plan approval, sampling-methodology sign-off, workpaper QA review, exception disposition gate before issue write-up.

sampling_methodology_enum.description: Sampling methodology used to select the test population. Drives confidence-interval reporting in workpaper-drafter and projection treatment in exception-analysis.

test_method_enum.description: How the control was tested. Inquiry alone is insufficient evidence of operating effectiveness under most firm testing standards.

exception_disposition_enum.description: How a flagged exception was resolved at the disposition gate. 'genuine-exception' routes to issue-writeup; 'pending-investigation' carries an open action with a target date.
